answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a violet bet on surviving 119 epochs of grading, and every garden settlement recomputes the ocean schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 119 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 3 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
